effect.2: Hand out two sips: one each to two people, or both to one person. You can pick yourself.
effect.3: Hand out three sips: one each to three people, or several to one. You can pick yourself.
effect.4: Hand out four sips among anyone you like. You can pick yourself too.
effect.7: Put the card in front of you. At any moment do the “Batman”: put your hands together like glasses and hold them to your eyes. The last person to notice and copy the move drinks.
effect.9: Rhymes. Say a word, and each next person says a rhyme to it. Whoever repeats a word or says nothing drinks.
effect.10: The people to your left and right take a sip.
effect.J: Put the card in front of you. At any moment rest your fist on a surface. The last person to make the gesture, or the last to notice it, takes a sip.
effect.Q: Put the card in front of you. The first person who answers any question you ask drinks.
effect.A: A new rule of the game. Anything goes: penalties x2, guys drink double, talking only in questions, no swearing, the sky is the limit.
effect.king: That is king {{number}} of {{total}}. Nothing happens, but the fourth king ends the game.
effect.lastKing: The fourth king! The game is over. Down all the alcohol you have left in one go.

OverheardConversation.name: Overheard Conversation
OverheardConversation.effect: Play immediately: look at the identity card of one of the players sitting next to you.

OpinionMaker.name: Opinion Maker
OpinionMaker.effect: Stays until the end of the game: you choose and reveal your Vote card before the others.

EstablishConfidence.name: Establish Confidence
EstablishConfidence.effect: Play immediately: the leader shows their identity card to another player.

OpenUp.name: Open Up
OpenUp.effect: Play immediately: show your identity card to another player (it may be the leader).

NoConfidence.name: No Confidence
NoConfidence.effect: One-time: reject an approved team, the vote counts as failed.

KeepingCloseEye.name: Keeping a Close Eye on You
KeepingCloseEye.effect: One-time: after the mission cards are played, look at one of the cards played.

StrongLeader.name: Strong Leader
StrongLeader.effect: One-time: take over the lead before the leader does anything.

InTheSpotlight.name: In the Spotlight
InTheSpotlight.effect: One-time: force another player to play their mission card openly.

TakeResponsibility.name: Take Responsibility
TakeResponsibility.effect: One-time: take another player's Plot card.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text: The players are secretly split into the Resistance and the Spies. At most 5 missions are played, and the team that scores 3 points first wins. The spies know each other, the Resistance does not know who the spies are.

round.title: A round
round.text: The leader picks a team of the required size (they may pick themselves). Everyone discusses, then votes simultaneously and openly: Approve or Reject. A tie rejects the team, and the lead passes on.

mission.title: The mission
mission.text: Each member of the approved team secretly plays a Success or a Fail card. The Resistance must play Success, a spy may play either. The mission fails if at least one Fail card was played (in mission 4 with 7 or more players two are needed).

plot.title: Plot cards (add-on)
plot.text: If the host enables the add-on before the game is opened, the leader draws Plot cards at the start of every mission (not after a rejected team): 1 with 5-6 players, 2 with 7-8, 3 with 9-10, and deals them to the other players (the “Establish Confidence” card stays with the leader). The number of cards in every player's hand is public, the cards themselves are secret, and everyone sees every card played.

makers.name: Opinion Maker
makers.text: goes on the table at once. Its owner votes on the team first, openly and without changing it; two Opinion Makers vote at the same time.

immediate.name: Overheard Conversation, Establish Confidence, Open Up
immediate.text: are played at once. The chosen player (or neighbour) sees an identity card and confirms it with a button.

strongLeader.name: Strong Leader
strongLeader.text: takes over the lead before the leader does anything.

noConfidence.name: No Confidence
noConfidence.text: rejects an approved team; it counts as a rejected team.

spotlight.name: In the Spotlight
spotlight.text: forces a team member to play their mission card openly.

take.name: Take Responsibility
take.text: takes a Plot card from another player (the visible Opinion Maker or a random card from the hand).

closeEye.name: Keeping a Close Eye on You
closeEye.text: after the mission (before “Next”) lets you look at another player's mission card; each card can be looked at by one player only.

plot.footer: When anyone holds a card (other than the Opinion Maker), everyone confirms before the team is picked or after it is approved that they are not playing a card, so nobody can tell who holds one.

end.title: End of the game
end.text: The Resistance wins after 3 successful missions. The Spies win after 3 failed missions or when 5 teams in a row are rejected in one mission.
